messages:
mike: heads up — saw a weird billing diff in console after a reconnect + model fallback. client sent EOF during a toolcall stream, reconnect routed to a different quantized variant and the final confirmed tokens are ~30% lower than provisional, console shows a negative adjustment. looks like tokenization mismatch between variants. anyone seen this? :thinking:
anya: ugh. do you have the session id / route?
mike: session=cli-7b-2026-03-21-xx, route=/v1/stream/generate, orig_model=mosaic-7b-q4, fallback=mosaic-7b-q4a-q5 (quantized), provisional_tokens=1024, confirmed_tokens=720, provisional->confirmed delta -304 shown as credit.
devon: quick q — was KV prefix cached and resumed or did the client restart with a fresh session id? that affects prefix attribution.
mike: client reconnected using same session token (we attach X-Session: cli-7b-2026-03-21-xx). server logs show resume path.
sofia: that rules out orphaned prefixes. two possibilities: 1) tokenization differences between q4 and q5 variants (e.g., bytepair vs sentencepiece) causing different token counts; or 2) our provisional accounting used the initial model's tokenizer but confirmation used the variant's tokenizer post-swap.
anya: can we repro by forcing a mid-stream model swap? maybe a canary routing policy triggered fallback due to capacity.
devon: repro plan: send a long toolcall, force an artificial EOF, then trigger fallback via capacity tag. I'll try on staging.
ops-bot: deploy-billing-svc v2.14 rolled at 2026-03-20T23:40Z — includes provisional->confirmed ledger merge change.
sofia: if confirmed.ledger now normalizes tokens to model_variant at confirmation time, that explains it. we should probably persist the tokenizer id at provisional time to avoid re-tokenizing under a different scheme.
mike: workaround for now: pin model variant per session with header `X-Session-Model: mosaic-7b-q4` so routing can't swap mid-session.
anya: also update console UX to show model_variant and tokenizer used in provisional vs confirmed lines — users will stop panicking.
devon: agreed. added to eng-platform backlog: "persist tokenizer id at provisional charge; console show tokenizer/model per charge" — I'll attach repro results.
sofia: long-term we should ensure fallback routing keeps tokenizer-compatible variants or emits a tokenization-migration adjustment metric.
mike: thanks — tagging @devon @sofia to follow-up. assigning P1 if we can reproduce on staging. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: billing-alert: session cli-7b-2026-03-21-xx generated provisional-credit then confirmed-refund delta=304 tokens, customer-impact=false, internal-only=true.
anya: repro attempt succeeded on staging. sending logs + minimal repro script in #eng-platform-gists.
sofia: nice. next: propose a small schema change to provisional ledger: add `tokenizer_id` and `model_variant_id` fields so re-tokenization is impossible. low-risk migration.
mike: thanks all — leaving this thread for backlog triage.
